title: Frame Toby
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Toby returns to the office after being in Costa Rica, prompting Michael to express mixed feelings towards him. Jim plans a surprise for Pam involving a house, while office antics include a police search of Toby's desk that leads to humorous confusion over a salad mistaken for drugs. The episode explores relationships, workplace conflicts, and humorous misunderstandings.
